timingSplit.partitionFormula: wallClockMs = outerPrepMergeParseMs (Σ inclusive ms of spans outside layout.pipeline: prep.cache+merge.plans+parse.nodes+parse.tfd) + layoutPipelineExclNestedPrepMs (ms(layout.pipeline) − ms(pipeline.prep)) + pipelinePrepMs (ms(pipeline.prep), nested inside layout.pipeline — fires ONLY on the rcll variant, expected 0 for the v2/strata builders on this branch) + remainderMs (wallClockMs − Σ top-level spans; seam/metric overhead outside all spans). Inclusive ms used throughout (selfMs is unreliable for nested spans); NO new spans added by W12.
timingSplit.seamNote: verified on this branch: vitest has no Worker global and pipeline/strata layout modes take runSequential inside layoutTerraformViaWorkers, so layout runs IN-PROCESS and terraformImportProfiler is reachable through the worker seam; per-cell fired span names are recorded in each arm's timing.timingSplit (pipeline.prep fires only on the rcll variant — expected 0 for v2/strata arms)
